correctness.rationale: For each r in (0,1), Legendre recurrence derives exact degree-n coefficients (2n+1)r^n(1+aS_n+bT_n). n=0,1 and n→infinity supply the three necessary affine inequalities. For all n>=2, the displayed positive rational barycentric weights satisfy both coefficient identities and sum to one identically; their determinant is (1-r²)^2(r²+15)/(120r³)>0, so all higher coefficients are strictly positive on the feasible region. Schoenberg yields PSD iff three conditions, and the standard strict-PD and all-coefficient universality criteria distinguish finite-site strictness from C-universality. Pairwise facet intersections give the two admissible vertices and nonredundancy.
